text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of my drink! A triumph
for
science!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But... your eyes say this was just
coincidence. And I do concede, rushing
to a conclusion based on a
single trial is
bad science.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I understand what you're trying to say.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to repeat this experiment
several times. So go ahead and choose
whatever game
you like—racing,
fighting, you name it!
